bribe verb

also bribery, bribes, take a bribe, influenced by bribery, corrupt (with money), bribed

classical

Traupman 193

corrumpō, corrumpere, corrūpī, corruptum

verb, third conjugation; with pecūniā, pretiō, dōnīs · Conjugation on Wiktionary

bribe, buy over

Other words

  • corruptēla, corruptēlae f. — bribery, corruption

    noun, first declension · also used · classical · Lewis & Short s.v. corruptēla; Traupman 194 · Declension on Wiktionary

  • largītiō, largītiōnis f. — bribery (with gifts), largesse

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Cic. Planc. 37: turpī largītiōne (Lewis & Short s.v. corrumpō) · Declension on Wiktionary

Examples

  • pretium

    bribes (literally “the price”)Traupman 193

  • corruptus, corrupta, corruptum
